svg.text: Test setup for step 3. Only the laptop USB is needed: the scale runs on 3.3 V from the Nucleo.
USB cable to the laptop (power and code)
arrow on the bar points down
HOW TO MOUNT THE LOAD CELL
1. One end screwed to the base,
the other end holds the plate.
3. Arrow on the bar points down.
Load cell cable: red E+, black E−,
white A−, green A+ (colours vary by brand)
Powered at 3.3 V, so its DT signal is safe
Channel A, gain 128 (chosen by the code)
10 readings per second (fixed on most boards)
1. Wire everything with the USB unplugged.
2. Solder the thin load cell wires (or use a terminal).
3. Never press more than 5 kg on the bar.
4. Weight reads negative: swap A+ and A−.
6. Check every Nucleo pin label before plugging.
Kibbly hardware · circuit 2 of the circuits by part · wires H1 to H12 in hardware/04_wiring_list.md section 7
